caseNameFull: Gillmor v. Indianapolis Gas Co. Abrams v. Indianapolis Gas Co. and Pyramid Commercial Corp. v. Indianapolis Gas Co.
attorneys: Mr. Frank E. Karelsen, Jr. for petitioners. Mr. Louis B. Embank for the Indianapolis Gas Co.; and Messrs. William H. Thompson, Perry E. O’Neal, and Patrick J. Smith for the City of Indianapolis, — respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.

Reported below: 136 F. 2d 925.
